BiblicalUsage: The minstrels were already playing at Jairus's house when Jesus arrived, making a noise over the dead girl, and John says the voice of harpers and musicians and pipers will be heard no more in fallen Babylon. The word is the flute-player, the hired mourner.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the minstrels show the two ends of music: at Jairus's house the noise stopped when Life walked in, and in Babylon the music stops because judgment has come.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
